blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.
blocks.zh: LLM服务选择需要反映当前任务要求的性能证据. 综合分数掩盖了能力和难度的差异,而精密相关的例子可能涉及不同的技能组合. 我们介绍的是RouteAlign,它使用任务要求来安排模型性能的衡量和服务的选择. 任务要求描述了能力需求和难度,使得能够与相应的模型性能测量保持一致. 历史要求决定成果如何有助于全球概况和地方能力估计;即将到来的要求决定这些计量如何为当前决定提供依据。 共享计分员整合证据,代成本优先控制合格服务的选择. 对不同任务和不同LLM服务的评价表明,RouteAlign将经验性的质量成本前沿延伸到更高的任务质量。 与开放的Jev风格决策后端的比较显示,质量收益一致,其生成成本低于其最强的测试配置. 缩写支持了当地性能证据的贡献,而编目更新实验则证明,配有刷新模型测量的计分器有效再利用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Applications increasingly draw on large language models (LLMs) as services for tasks that span knowledge, reasoning, programming, and interaction with external systems. The breadth of foundation-model applications [ 4 ] makes the choice of service consequential: the same candidate may be suitable for routine requests yet unreliable on a demanding combination of skills. Service-oriented computing provides the architectural basis for invoking interchangeable functionality [ 30 ] , and classical service selection compares eligible alternatives under quality-of-service (QoS) constraints [ 45 ] . For LLMs, however, task quality must be estimated for the particular request before the selected service executes it. An interface establishes how a model can be invoked; effective selection additionally requires evidence of what that model can accomplish under the current task demands.
blocks.zh: 应用程序越来越多地取用大型语言模型(LLMS),作为涵盖知识、推理、编程和与外部系统互动的任务的服务。 基础模型应用的广度[4]使得对服务的选择成为必然结果:同一候选人可能适合常规申请,但对于要求很高的技能组合却不可靠。 以服务为导向的计算为引用可互换功能提供了建筑基础[30],而古典服务选择则在服务质量(QoS)的限制下比较了符合条件的替代品[45]. 但是,对于LLMS,在选定服务执行之前,必须估计特定请求的任务质量. 一个界面可以确定如何引用一个模型;有效的选择还需要证明该模型在当前任务要求下能够实现什么目标。

blocks.en: The central challenge is determining which past outcomes support that estimate. Holistic evaluation reveals substantial variation across scenarios and quality dimensions [ 22 ] , and the Benchmark Lottery shows that relative model rankings can change with the choice of evaluation tasks [ 9 ] . Dynabench further demonstrates the value of targeted challenge examples for exposing model failures [ 18 ] . Even within a topic, requests can require different combinations of capabilities. Consider identifying incorrect statistics in a Python script and repairing its implementation. Superficially similar programming examples may test routine syntax, algorithm design, or quantitative analysis, each providing different evidence about the requested repair. Instruction-following constraints introduce another source of variation, as illustrated by IFEval [ 49 ] ; reasoning demands can also change the interpretation of measured performance, as shown on BIG-Bench Hard [ 37 ] . Figure 1 illustrates the resulting selection problem. A useful model description must preserve the conditions under which performance was observed, and a selector must consult that description according to the capabilities and difficulty of the incoming task.
blocks.zh: 中心挑战是确定哪些过去的成果支持这一估计。 整体评价揭示了不同情景和质量维度之间的巨大差异[22],而"基准彩票"显示,相对模型排名会随着评价任务的选择而变化 [9]. Dynabench进一步证明了有针对性的挑战实例对于揭露模型故障的价值[18]. 即使在某一专题内,请求也可能需要不同的能力组合。 考虑在 Python 脚本中识别不正确的统计并修复其执行. 超相相类似的编程示例可能测试常规语法,算法设计,或定量分析,每个实例都为所请求的修补提供了不同的证据. 正如IFEval[49]所说明的,指令后的限制引入了另一种变异来源;推理要求也可以改变对所计量性能的解释,如BIG-Bench Hard [37]所显示. 图1说明了由此产生的甄选问题。 有用的模型描述必须保留观察业绩的条件,选择者必须根据即将完成的任务的能力和难度查阅这一描述。

blocks.en: Existing routing results establish the value of exploiting model complementarity [ 16 ] . RouteLLM learns pairwise preferences [ 29 ] , RouterDC learns query-model compatibility [ 7 ] , and nearest-neighbor routing estimates quality from similar tasks [ 21 ] . These advances motivate a practical question: which parts of a model’s performance history are informative for a request that combines several capabilities? Global measurements provide coverage across topics, whereas related tasks preserve local context. Combining them requires distinguishing semantic resemblance from the capability demands associated with an observed outcome. This issue persists when the catalog changes. Dependencies among models, data, and system configuration complicate maintenance [ 34 ] ; empirical studies also identify data versioning and model reuse as distinct software-engineering challenges [ 2 ] . A selector should therefore accommodate updated candidate evidence while preserving a consistent rule for comparing services.
blocks.zh: 现有路由结果确定了利用模型互补的价值[16]. RouteLLM 学习对等偏好 [29], 路由器 DC从类似任务中学习查询-模型相容性[7],而最近的-邻居路由估计质量[21]. 这些进步引发了一个实际问题:一个模型的性能历史中哪些部分对于一个结合了几种能力的请求是信息化的? 全球计量涵盖各种专题,而相关任务则保护当地环境。 将它们结合起来需要区分语义上的相似性与与观察到的结果有关的能力要求。 当目录发生变化时,这个问题依然存在。 模型、数据和系统配置的依赖性使维护 [34] ;经验研究还确定数据版本和模型再利用是不同的软件工程挑战[2]。 因此,甄选人应接受最新的候选人证据,同时为比较服务保留一致的规则。

The task combines coding, reasoning, and data analysis with weights of 0.50, 0.33, and 0.17 at difficulty L3. The model profiles of services A, B, and C express performance in the same capability coordinates.
blocks.zh: 图1:对LLM服务选择的查询-模型匹配和要求外观调整的概念比较. 任务结合了编码,推理,以及数据分析,加权为0.50分,0.33分,难度为L3. 0.17分. 服务A、B和C的模型剖面显示在同一能力坐标上的性能。

blocks.en: We introduce RouteAlign to retain the task conditions that make past performance informative for a new request. In the programming example, results on statistical reasoning and routine code editing inform different aspects of the requested repair, even when the task descriptions are semantically close. The method preserves these distinctions through profiles of performance under different capability demands and difficulty levels, together with estimates from related tasks. Within that neighborhood, each outcome’s influence depends on semantic proximity and the capability demands of both the historical and current tasks. The resulting estimate reflects how a candidate’s measured competence matches the request’s capability mixture. A shared scorer learns to combine broad performance coverage with this local context. A common measurement schema allows the learned scoring rule to be reused when candidate evidence is refreshed after catalog changes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RouteAlign,以保留使过去的业绩为新请求提供信息的任务条件。 在编程实例中,统计推理和常规代码编辑的结果为所请求的修补的不同方面提供了信息,即使任务描述的高度接近. 该方法通过不同能力要求和难度水平下的业绩概况以及相关任务的估计数来保持这些区别。 在附近地区,每个结果的影响都取决于语义上的相近程度以及历史和当前任务的能力要求。 由此得出的估计数反映了候选人所衡量的能力如何与申请的能力混合。 共享分数者学习将广泛的业绩覆盖与当地的这种背景相结合. 一个共同的测量方案允许在目录更改后对候选证据进行更新时,重新使用所学得分规则。

blocks.en: Across ten datasets and 13 candidate LLMs, RouteAlign achieves the highest Sample-Avg and Dataset-Avg among the evaluated routing baselines, exceeding RouteLLM by 1.38 and 2.22 percentage points at 1.05% higher generation cost. It also exceeds the strongest tested open Jev-style configuration by 5.22 and 6.44 points on the respective metrics at 9.7% lower generation cost. The quality gains persist across decision backends and scoring mixtures, supporting the combination of requirement-conditioned measurements and local performance evidence. Ablations identify local evidence as the most consequential feature group. Timing studies quantify cached selection and online requirement prediction. In controlled catalog updates, refreshed measurements let the retained scorer respond to changes in available services and prices.
blocks.zh: 在10个数据集和13个候选LLMs中,RouteAlign在评估的路由基线中实现了最高的Sample-Avg和Dataset-Avg,比RouteLLM高出1.38和2.22个百分点,提高了1.05%的生成成本。 它还以9.7%的低生成成本,在相应的度量衡上以5.22分和6.44分超过测试最强的开放式Jev型配置. 在决策后端和评分混合物中,质量的提高一直存在,支持将有要求的计量与当地业绩证据结合起来。 校正将本地证据确定为最间接的特征组. 时机研究量化缓存选择和在线需求预测. 在受控目录更新中,刷新后的测量让被保留的计分员应对现有服务和价格的变化.

blocks.en: The paper makes three contributions: • A requirement-aware formulation of LLM service selection that separates task competence, service eligibility, and generation-cost preference. Shared capability and difficulty coordinates make the relationship between task demands and measured model performance explicit. • A requirement-profile alignment mechanism that combines difficulty-conditioned model profiles with local estimates conditioned on the capabilities required by both historical and incoming tasks. A shared scorer integrates these complementary measurements across candidate services. • An empirical assessment spanning established routers, open Jev-style decision backends, and direct candidate invocation. Quality, generation cost, ablations, execution overhead, and catalog updates jointly examine the effectiveness and reuse of the selection policy.
blocks.zh: 该文件作出了三项贡献: 制定符合要求的LLM服务选择,将任务能力、服务资格和生成成本的偏好区分开来。 共享能力和难度协调使任务要求与衡量模型性能之间的关系变得明确。 以历史和新任务所需能力为条件,将条件困难的模型简介与当地估计相结合的要求调整机制。 共用计分员将这些补充计量纳入各候选服务。 包括既定路由器、开放的Jev式决定后端和直接援引候选人的经验评估。 质量、生成成本、活化、执行间接费用和目录更新共同审查甄选政策的有效性和再利用情况。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Service Selection and Task-Dependent Quality
blocks.zh: 2.1 服务选择和任务依赖性质量

blocks.en: Service selection traditionally compares functionally suitable candidates through QoS attributes and application preferences. Zeng et al. [ 45 ] formulate utility-based selection under user constraints and examine task-level and global allocation in composite services. Their retrospective [ 44 ] identifies stochastic outputs and unstructured data as challenges for composition involving LLMs. For an LLM invocation, task-dependent competence is itself a quantity to be estimated before candidates can be compared. RouteAlign addresses this estimation problem within an available service catalog: requirements condition the performance evidence, metadata determines admissibility, and generation cost enters the selection preference. This formulation connects service descriptions to invocation-time selection.
blocks.zh: 服务选择传统上通过QoS属性和应用程序偏好来比较功能上适合的候选人. 曾等编. [45] 在用户制约下制定基于公用事业的选择,并审查综合服务中的任务级别和全球分配。 其回顾性[44]指出,有条理的产出和无结构的数据是涉及法学硕士的构成方面的挑战。 就援引LLM而言,依赖任务的能力本身就是在对候选人进行比较之前要估计的数量。 RouteAlign在可用服务目录中解决了这一估计问题:要求以性能证据为条件,元数据决定可采性,生成成本进入选择偏好. 这种提法将服务描述与引用时间选择相连接.

blocks.en: 2.2 LLM Routing and Resource Allocation
blocks.zh: 2.2 LLM(低强度) 路线和资源分配

blocks.en: Pre-generation routing estimates which model should answer a request from information available before candidate execution. Hybrid LLM [ 10 ] predicts quality differences, RouteLLM [ 29 ] learns from pairwise preferences, and RouterDC [ 7 ] uses contrastive query-model objectives. Reward-based supervision provides another source of such evidence: ZOOTER [ 23 ] distills rewards into a routing policy, while Routoo [ 27 ] couples predicted performance with cost-aware selection. RouteAlign also makes its decision before response generation, with a focus on how task requirements structure and weight the measurements supplied to that decision.
blocks.zh: 生成前路线估计,哪个模型应响应候选人执行前现有信息的要求。 Hybrid LLM [10] 预测质量差异, RouteLLM [29] 从对等偏好中学习,而 RouterDC [7] 使用对比性查询-模型目标. 基于奖励的监管为这种证据提供了又一来源:ZOOTER[23]将奖励提炼成通向政策,而Routoo[27]夫妇则以成本意识的选择预测性能. RouteAlign公司也在生成响应之前作出决定,重点是任务要求如何结构和加权向该决定提供的测量。

blocks.en: Other approaches extend the allocation decision across executions or adapt it from feedback. FrugalGPT [ 5 ] learns model cascades, and AutoMix [ 1 ] uses answer verification to decide when to invoke a larger model. MixLLM [ 40 ] formulates allocation as a contextual bandit, while BEST-Route [ 11 ] jointly selects a model and the number of sampled responses. These settings introduce sequential or resource-allocation decisions beyond choosing a single service for the current invocation.
blocks.zh: 其他办法将分配决定扩大到整个执行期间,或根据反馈意见加以调整。 FrugalGPT [5] 学习模型级联,AutoMix [1] 使用答案验证来决定何时引用更大的模型. MixLLM [40] 将分配设定为上下文的"强盗",而BEST-Route [11] 联合选择一个模型和抽样答复的数量. 这些设置除了为当前引用选择单一服务外,还引入了相继或资源分配的决定.

blocks.en: Evaluation resources separate policy design from the collection of model outcomes. RouterBench [ 15 ] supplies reusable inference records, RouterEval [ 16 ] examines model complementarity, and LLMRouterBench [ 20 ] supports comparison under a common routing protocol. LLMRouter [ 13 ] provides tools for implementing and deploying routing policies. Following this emphasis on comparable evidence, our evaluation uses a common held-out workload and reports task quality alongside recorded generation charges.
blocks.zh: 评价资源将政策设计与收集示范成果分开。 路由器 Bench [15] 提供可再使用的推论记录,路由器 Eval [16] 检查模型互补,LLMRouter Bench [20] 支持在通用路由协议下进行比较. LLMRouter [13] 为执行和部署路线政策提供了工具。 在强调可比证据之后,我们的评价采用共同的搁置工作量和报告任务质量以及记录的生成费用。

blocks.en: 2.3 Task Requirements and Model Performance Evidence
blocks.zh: 2.3 任务要求和示范业绩证据

blocks.en: Model documentation gives performance measurements an explicit context. Model Cards [ 26 ] record intended uses, evaluation conditions, and disaggregated results; Datasheets for Datasets [ 14 ] document data composition, collection, and intended use. Holistic evaluation [ 22 ] compares language models across scenarios and metrics, while CheckList [ 33 ] tests specific capabilities that aggregate accuracy can overlook. Benchmark design further specifies the demands under evaluation: FLORES-200 examines multilingual translation [ 28 ] , and WritingBench evaluates diverse writing requirements [ 42 ] . WebArena measures interactive task completion [ 50 ] , while HarmBench evaluates harmful behavior and robust refusal [ 25 ] . These studies motivate preserving the task conditions underlying model measurements. RouteAlign gives those conditions a computational role by using capability demand and difficulty to organize and consult empirical evidence.
blocks.zh: 示范文献为业绩计量提供了明确的背景。 示范卡[26]记录了预期用途,评价条件和分门别类的结果; 数据集数据表[14]记录了数据的组成,收集和预期用途. 整体评价[22]比较不同情景和度量标准的语言模型,而CheckList[33]测试总精度可以忽略的具体能力. 基准设计进一步明确了评价中的要求:FLORES-200审查多语种翻译[28],而Writing Bench评价不同的写作要求[42]. WebArena措施交互任务完成 [50],而Harm Bench则评价有害行为和强烈拒绝 [25]. 这些研究促使保持模型测量的基本任务条件。 RouteAlign通过利用能力需求和困难来组织和参考经验证据,赋予这些条件一个计算作用.

blocks.en: Routing methods operationalize model descriptions in several ways. GraphRouter [ 12 ] models relationships among tasks, queries, and candidates. UniRoute [ 17 ] derives model features from predictions on representative prompts, whereas ICL-Router [ 38 ] conditions routing on in-context representations of query and model performance. AvengersPro [ 46 ] summarizes quality and efficiency within query clusters, and nearest-neighbor routing [ 21 ] estimates quality from similar tasks. These approaches motivate examining both the structure of candidate representations and the locality of supporting evidence.
blocks.zh: 跑道方法以几种方式操作模型描述. 图鲁特[12] 工作、询问和候选人之间的模型关系。 UniRoute [17] 从对代表性提示的预测中得出了模型特征,而ICL-Router [38] 条件则来自对查询和模型性能的内在表达。 AvengersPro [46]总结了查询组内的质量和效率,最近的邻接路线[21]从类似任务中估计出质量. 这些办法促使审查候选人代表的结构和证明证据的地点。

blocks.en: Task structure further specifies what that evidence measures. IRT-Router [ 36 ] relates query difficulty to model ability, and InferenceDynamics [ 35 ] constructs capability and knowledge profiles. SkillOrchestra [ 39 ] derives skill-specific competence from execution experience for agent orchestration. DecoR [ 24 ] decomposes query requirements to guide matching against historical records. RouteAlign brings these forms of evidence into a common requirement representation. Model profiles retain capability and difficulty conditions, and local estimates adjust the influence of semantically related outcomes according to task demand. The shared scorer compares candidates through features with consistent meanings across the service catalog.
blocks.zh: 任务结构进一步明确了证据措施。 IRT-Router [36] 将查询困难与模型能力联系起来,推论动态 [35] 构建能力和知识剖面. Skill Orchestra[39]从执行经验中获得了特有技能的能力,用于代理管弦乐. DecoR [24] 分解查询要求,以指导与历史记录相匹配. 路由统一使这些证据形式成为共同的要求表述。 模型简介保留了能力和难度条件,当地估计根据任务需求调整与精密相关的结果的影响. 共享分数者通过各服务目录中具有一致意义的特征来比较考生.

blocks.en: 3 Requirement-Aware LLM Service Selection
blocks.zh: 3 要求- 了解 LLM 服务选择

blocks.en: 3.1 Service Catalog and Selection Scope
blocks.zh: 3.1 服务目录和选择范围

blocks.en: Consider an application with access to a catalog ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} of LLM services at deployment version t t . Each candidate m m represents configured access to a particular model version. Its model determines task competence, while its service configuration specifies execution attributes such as context capacity, supported modalities, tool access, and availability. A request x x , together with its supplied context, requires one eligible candidate to be selected before response generation. The decision selects one invocation target from the available catalog.
blocks.zh: 考虑在部署版本 t 中访问 LLM 服务的目录 Mt\ mathcal{M}_{t} 的应用程序 。 每个候选人 m m 代表一个特定的模型版本的配置访问. 它的模式决定了任务能力,而它的服务配置则指定了执行属性,如上下文能力,被支持的模式,工具访问和可用性等. 请求 xx 及其提供的背景要求,在生成响应之前必须选定一名合格的候选人。 决定从可用的目录中选择一个引用目标.

blocks.en: The empirical study represents each service candidate by its model configuration and recorded responses. We use routing to refer to existing methods and to implementations of this selection decision.
blocks.zh: 经验研究通过其模式配置和记录的答复代表每个服务候选人。 我们用路线来指代现有的方法和这一甄选决定的执行情况。

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Requirements and Model Profiles
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务要求和模式简介

blocks.en: A compact profiler h ϕ h_{\phi} predicts capability weights and difficulty from the request text. Its ten capability coordinates cover task understanding, domain knowledge, reasoning, software engineering, complex information synthesis, data analysis, multilingual understanding, content generation, interactive execution, and risk control. Four difficulty levels range from direct facts and simple transformations to expert analysis and extended planning. A task can assign positive weight to several capabilities, preserving the mixture needed for completion.

We formulate profiling as instruction-conditioned generation of structured annotations, building on instruction tuning as a means of learning from task descriptions [ 41 ] . Qwen3-0.6B [ 43 ] receives full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in LlamaFactory [ 48 ] , using approximately 21,000 GPT-5.4-annotated task profiles. The source pool covers the ten capabilities, including program synthesis in HumanEval [ 6 ] , numerical reasoning over financial data in FinQA [ 8 ] , and document reasoning in LongBench v2 [ 3 ] . Train-test overlap can distort model evaluation [ 19 ] . We therefore first exclude every source dataset present in the routing test workload, then remove residual overlap using token 3-grams: a candidate is discarded when its overlap covers at least 10% of a compared test sample’s 3-grams. Training minimizes loss on the target profile only. The same deterministic profiler annotates historical and incoming tasks; execution requirements are supplied separately through metadata. The Supplementary Material gives the source inventory, filtering rule, and training settings.

blocks.en: Global and local estimates summarize different aspects of performance but may share predictive information. RouteAlign fits one linear quality estimator, q ^ ​ ( x , m ) = θ ⊤ ​ f ​ ( x , m ) \widehat{q}(x,m)=\theta^{\top}f(x,m) , jointly across candidates. Its ten features include the two global compatibility scores, scalar and capability-conditioned local quality, the sample-category mean b b , the category-by-difficulty mean g g , and four local comparison features. The latter comprise local quality multiplied by candidate separation, the margin over the strongest eligible alternative, an indicator of the highest local estimate, and disagreement with the category-by-difficulty mean. Joint fitting determines the contribution of each estimate in the presence of the others.

blocks.en: The terms sample-category prior and category-by-difficulty prior refer to empirical means of training outcomes, selected using an auxiliary sample-category prediction. An empty category-by-difficulty stratum falls back to the category mean. Candidate separation is the maximum local quality minus the mean across eligible candidates; in the benchmark, it is normalized by the mean separation in the corresponding feature-extraction batch. Selection ties follow a deterministic candidate order, and a single eligible candidate uses zero as the reference for its margin. These definitions are shared across models, so candidate identity indexes evidence without defining a learned output class. The Supplementary Material gives the complete feature vector and specifies how missing records are handled.

blocks.en: 4.5 Updating Evidence as the Service Catalog Changes
blocks.zh: 4.5 更新证据作为服务目录更改

blocks.en: The shared representation separates updates to candidate measurements from fitting the comparison rule. With task annotations fixed, each outcome-profile cell depends on a total requirement weight and a weighted sum of outcomes. Reference measurements for an added candidate populate its cells without changing those of existing candidates. A model replacement requires measurements for the new version, removal changes the active set, and repricing updates service metadata and the cost records used by the local estimator. Candidate-relative features are recomputed for the eligible set.
blocks.zh: 共享说明将候选人计量的更新与比较规则的匹配分开。 在确定任务说明后,每个成果说明单元都取决于总要求权重和成果加权和总和。 对新增候选人的参考测量在不改变现有候选人的单元格的情况下填充其单元格。 一个模型替换需要对新版本进行测量,去除会改变活性集,并重刻更新服务元数据以及当地估计器使用的成本记录. 候选人与候选人的相对特征在符合资格的组合中重新计算。

blocks.en: Requirement annotations and reference embeddings remain reusable as long as the profiler, schema, and reference tasks are unchanged. Newly measured candidates can then be expressed through the existing feature definitions and evaluated with retained scoring coefficients. Section 5.6 tests this property by fitting on an initial catalog, freezing the coefficients, and refreshing candidate evidence after each catalog update.
blocks.zh: 要求说明和参考嵌入只要配置器,方案以及参考任务不变,仍然可以重复使用. 然后再通过现有特征定义表达新计量的候选人,并以保留的评分系数进行评估。 第5.6节通过安装初始目录、冻结系数和在每个目录更新后更新候选证据来检验这种财产。

blocks.en: 5 Empirical Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 经验评价

blocks.en: The experiments assess selection quality and generation cost, the contributions of different feature groups, selection time, and scorer reuse after catalog changes. Four research questions organize the evaluation: • RQ1: Quality and cost. How does RouteAlign compare with existing routers, open Jev-style decision backends, and direct candidate invocation in quality and generation expenditure? • RQ2: Feature contributions. How do global, local, and requirement-conditioned estimates contribute to quality within the shared scorer? • RQ3: Execution overhead. How long does selection take with cached requirements and embeddings, and what latency is observed at a separate endpoint that also predicts requirements? • RQ4: Scorer reuse. Can coefficients fitted on an initial catalog remain effective after candidate evidence is refreshed to reflect catalog changes?
blocks.zh: 实验评估了选取质量和生成成本,不同特征组的贡献,选取时间,以及分数器在编目变化后再用. 组织评价的四个研究问题: • RQ1:质量和成本. RouteAlign如何与现有的路由器进行比较,打开Jev风格的决定后端,以及直接引用候选人在质量和生成支出方面的功能? 二. 支助 RQ2:特色贡献. 全球、地方和有要求的估计如何促进共享计分器的质量? 二. 支助 RQ3:执行费。 选择要花多长时间才有缓存要求和嵌入,在同样预测要求的单独端点上观察到的是什么样的延迟? 二. 支助 RQ4:分数再用. 在更新候选证据以反映目录变化之后,初始目录上的系数是否仍然有效?

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Datasets and Train-Test Split
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 数据集和列车试验

blocks.en: We use the requests, model responses, task scores, and generation costs recorded in LLMRouterBench [ 20 ] . The workload comprises AIME, ArenaHard, GPQA, HLE, LiveCodeBench, LiveMathBench, MMLU-Pro, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, and τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench. Partitioning by dataset and prompt with seed 42 and a 70% training fraction produces 8,710 training requests and 3,738 test requests. All responses to a request remain in the same partition. Model measurement, retrieval references, category priors, and scorer fitting use training records. A policy chooses a candidate before accessing its recorded test outcome.
blocks.zh: 我们使用LLMRouter Bench [20]中记录的请求、模型响应、任务分数和生成成本。 工作量包括:AIME、ArenaHard、GPQA、HLE、LiveCode Bench、LiveMath Bench、MMLU-Pro、SimpleQA、SWE-bench和\tau\2}-bench。 通过数据集进行分解,并迅速提供42个种子和70%的培训分数,可产生8 710个培训请求和3 738个测试请求。 对一项请求的所有答复都在同一分区内。 模型测量、检索参考文献、类别前科和计分员配备使用培训记录。 一项政策在获取其记录的测试结果之前选择候选人。

blocks.en: The 13 model configurations represent alternative LLM services whose recorded outcomes permit comparison on a shared workload. Direct-candidate results use available records: GPT-5 covers the full test workload, whereas GPT-5-Chat lacks τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench records. Dense retrieval features and regression targets use zero for absent records; global outcome profiles aggregate observed records only. RouteAlign selects an observed response for every test request. Dataset sizes, candidate coverage, and selection counts are reported in the Supplementary Material.

blocks.en: The comparison includes preference-based RouteLLM [ 29 ] , contrastive RouterDC [ 7 ] , three utility configurations of GraphRouter [ 12 ] , and cluster-based AvengersPro [ 46 ] . KNNRouter, SVMRouter, and MLPRouter provide classification-based comparisons [ 13 ] . We also evaluate three embedding-based retrieval policies, uniform random selection, and direct invocation of individual candidates. This set covers several ways of learning or aggregating historical performance evidence.
blocks.zh: 比较内容包括:以偏好为基础的RouteLLM [29],对比的RouterDC [7],Graph Router的三种功能配置[12],以集群为基础的复仇者Pro [46]. KNNRouter, SVMRouter,和MLPRouter提供以分类为基础的比较[13]. 我们还评价三项嵌入式检索政策、统一的随机选择和直接援引个别候选人。 本集涵盖学习或汇总历史性能证据的几种方法.

blocks.en: RouteLLM uses a multi-candidate matrix-factorization adaptation, and AvengersPro uses the benchmark implementation of cluster-based rank aggregation. Results refer to the implementations and training budgets detailed in the Supplementary Material. In particular, classification-based KNNRouter predicts a winning candidate label, whereas the retrieval-based policies estimate performance separately for each candidate.

blocks.en: RouteAlign achieves the highest aggregate quality among the evaluated policies in the fixed catalog, with 63.07% Sample-Avg and 68.64% Dataset-Avg (Table 1 ). The strongest competing router, RouteLLM, obtains 61.69% and 66.42%, respectively. blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Jev-Style Decision Models
blocks.zh: 5.3 与Jev-Style决定模式的比较

blocks.en: This comparison examines whether a general decision model supplied with task and model descriptions can replace the trained selection policy. We evaluate nine locally deployed, open Jev-style backends spanning 0.8B to 9B: three Kev sizes, two Open-Jev sizes, two Decider sizes, SemIf, and OpenJev-mjdileep. Each exposes typed choices and scores through a common local adapter.
blocks.zh: 这一比较审查了附有任务和模式说明的一般决定模式是否可以取代经过培训的甄选政策。 我们评价9个本地部署的,开放的Jev风格后端,从0.8B到9B:3个Kev大小,2个Open-Jev大小,2个决定器大小,SemIf和OpenJev-mjdileep. 每个都通过一个常见的本地适配器来曝光打出的选择和分数.

blocks.en: Every configuration uses the same 3,738 requests, 13-model catalog, and recorded outcomes. Each backend predicts requirements and rates candidate profile summaries, retaining the adapter’s metadata filtering and capability-tier matching. The backends receive no additional routing-task fine-tuning. We vary the decision-score weight ρ ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \rho\in\{0,0.5,1\} in a mixture with explicit requirement-profile compatibility. At ρ = 0 \rho=0 , the backend still supplies the requirements and candidate set, while compatibility determines the candidate scores. The comparison evaluates complete selection policies: the Jev-style variants use backend predictions and supplied profiles, and RouteAlign combines its supervised profiler with local outcome evidence and a fitted scorer.

blocks.en: The largest quality loss follows removal of all local quality evidence: 3.12 Dataset-Avg points and 1.66 Sample-Avg points. Even after refitting, global profiles and category priors do not replace the information supplied by related task outcomes. Removing the scalar neighborhood estimate alone costs 0.61 Dataset-Avg points and 0.19 Sample-Avg points. Removing the four relative local features lowers Dataset-Avg by 0.46 points but raises Sample-Avg by 0.15 points. Local evidence is therefore consequential at the group level, while its relative features affect quality differently under the two task-weighting conventions.

At similar observed generation expenditure, selection by the category-by-difficulty mean trails RouteAlign by 2.22 Dataset-Avg points and 1.62 Sample-Avg points. The complete policy therefore improves on selecting the candidate with the highest mean score in the predicted category and difficulty group. The supplementary comparison reports the complete decision rules and their generation costs.

Removing the four requirement-conditioned scores lowers Dataset-Avg by 0.25 points; removing the two global scores lowers it by 0.11 points. blocks.en: Setting λ = 0 \lambda=0 increases generation expenditure from $110.42 to $124.82, lowers Dataset-Avg by 0.37 points, and raises Sample-Avg by 0.25 points. The default preference reduces generation cost by 11.5% relative to this setting while changing the distribution of quality across tasks. Because the quality estimator is held fixed, the difference isolates the effect of applying the cost preference to the learned scores. The result shows that the preference changes candidate choices without refitting the scorer; its appropriate value depends on the workload and desired quality-cost balance.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: RouteAlign makes task requirements the basis for connecting measured model competence to service selection. Historical capability demands determine how outcomes form global profiles and local estimates; incoming demands determine how the shared scorer uses this evidence to assess candidate suitability. The resulting policy attains the highest quality on both empirical Pareto frontiers and exceeds the strongest tested Jev-style configuration by 6.44 Dataset-Avg points at 9.7% lower generation cost. The largest ablation loss follows removal of local evidence, establishing its central role in the fitted policy. RouteAlign-Frozen also leads across the tested catalog changes, showing that refreshed candidate measurements remain useful with the original scoring coefficients. These findings support requirement alignment as a consistent basis for combining global measurements, related task outcomes, and a reusable comparison rule.
blocks.zh: RouteAlign使任务要求成为连接所测量的模型能力与服务选择的基础. 历史能力要求确定结果如何构成全球概况和地方估计;收到的要求确定共享计分员如何利用这些证据评估候选人是否适合。 由此产生的政策在经验性的帕雷托边界上都取得了最高的质量,并且以9.7%的低发电成本,以6.44 Dataset-Avg点超过了最强的Jev型配置。 在去除当地证据之后,损失最大,这确立了其在相应政策中的核心作用。 RouteAlign-Frozen 也引领了经过测试的目录变化,显示刷新了的候选测量与原始分数系数仍然有用. 这些结论支持将需求统一起来,作为结合全球计量、相关任务成果和可重复使用的比较规则的一致基础。

blocks.en: 7.1 Capability Definitions
blocks.zh: 7.1 能力定义

blocks.en: The requirement schema expresses task demand through capability weights and a difficulty level. Its ten nonnegative weights sum to one, allowing several capabilities to contribute to the same request. Task profiles and model measurements use the following capabilities in a fixed order.
blocks.zh: 要求计划通过能力重量和难度来表示任务需求。 它的10个非负重相加为一相加,允许多个能力对同一请求作出贡献. 任务简介和模型测量按固定顺序使用以下能力.

blocks.en: C1. Task understanding and constraint adherence. Identifying explicit and implicit task goals, interpreting instructions and conversational intent, and satisfying substantive constraints, priorities, procedures, and output requirements. C2. Knowledge understanding and domain-specific question answering. Understanding and applying factual, commonsense, encyclopedic, and domain-specific knowledge to answer questions accurately. C3. Reasoning and quantitative problem solving. Drawing deductive or inductive inferences, performing quantitative calculations, constructing proofs, planning, analyzing causal relations, and decomposing complex problems. C4. Programming and software engineering. Generating, understanding, debugging, and testing code, implementing algorithms, and reasoning about software structure, repositories, and programming interfaces. C5. Complex information understanding and long-context synthesis. Locating and reconciling evidence in complex documents, long texts, or extended conversational context, with emphasis on integration across passages and sources. C6. Data analysis and structured information understanding. Understanding tables, statistics, and other structured representations; extracting, comparing, calculating, interpreting, or transforming their contents. C7. Multilingual understanding, translation, and localization. Understanding and expressing content across languages, translating meaning, and adapting wording to linguistic and cultural contexts. C8. Content generation and expression control. Generating, summarizing, rewriting, or expanding content while controlling organization, style, tone, and audience suitability. C9. Tool use and interactive task execution. Executing tasks through retrieval, code execution, function calls, or interaction with external systems, including coordination across multiple steps. C10. Safety, reliability, and risk control. Recognizing safety-sensitive requirements, handling consequential advice reliably, protecting privacy, and maintaining appropriate response and refusal boundaries.
blocks.zh: C1. 任务理解和遵守约束。 确定明确和隐含的任务目标,解释指示和谈话意图,并满足实质性限制、优先事项、程序和产出要求。 C2. 知识理解和特定领域问题的回答。 理解并应用事实,常识,百科全书,和域特有知识准确回答问题. C3. 合理和定量解决问题。 绘制推理或诱导推断,进行定量计算,构建证明,规划,分析因果关系,并分解复杂的问题. C5. 复杂的信息理解和长文综合。 确定和调和复杂文件、长文或扩展对话背景中的证据,并注重跨段落和来源的整合。 C6. 数据分析和结构化信息理解。 理解表格、统计数据和其他结构化表述;提取、比较、计算、解释或转变其内容。 C7. 多语种理解、翻译和本地化。 理解和表达跨语言的内容,翻译含义,使措辞适应语言和文化背景. blocks.en: 7.2 Difficulty Levels
blocks.zh: 7.2 难度

blocks.en: Difficulty specifies the required level of knowledge, reasoning, constraint interaction, and execution complexity. L1 comprises direct facts and simple transformations; L2 covers bounded reasoning and standard knowledge application; L3 includes substantial multistep reasoning, complex code analysis, or synthesis; and L4 covers expert analysis, extended planning, or tasks that combine several demanding capabilities. These levels apply to the task as a whole, alongside its capability mixture. The introductory illustration in the main paper abbreviates C4, C3, and C6 as coding, reasoning, and data analysis, respectively.
blocks.zh: 难度规定了所需知识水平、推理、制约互动和执行的复杂性。 L1包含直接事实和简单的转化;L2包含有界限的推理和标准的知识应用;L3包含有实质性的多步推理,复杂的代码分析,或综合;而L4包含专家分析,扩展规划,或结合几个要求能力的任务. 这些水平适用于整个任务,与其能力混合。 主论文中的引言分别将C4,C3和C6作为编码,推理和数据分析.

blocks.en: 7.4 Full-Parameter Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 7.4 监督全平面图

blocks.en: We fine-tune Qwen3-0.6B [ 43 ] with LlamaFactory [ 48 ] . Each input contains the profiling instructions and the request with its supplied context. The target is a structured record containing all ten capability weights and one difficulty level. Annotation instructions assess the capabilities necessary for successful completion from the request and supplied context, with reference answers, candidate identities, and source-dataset labels excluded from the annotation input. The training objective is conditional token cross-entropy over the target profile; instruction and request tokens are masked from the loss. The supervised output thus describes the demands of the task.
blocks.zh: 我们微调了Quen3-0.6B [43] 与Llama Factory [48]. 每个输入都包含剖面说明和提供上下文的请求。 目标是一个结构化的记录,包含所有十种能力重量和一个难度级别. 注释指示评估成功完成请求和提供上下文所必需的能力,并附有参考答案、候选身份和不包括在注释输入中的源数据集标签。 培训目标是在目标剖面上标出有条件的标志;指示和请求的标志被蒙上损失的面具. 因此,受监督的产出说明了任务的要求。

blocks.en: Training updates all model parameters for one epoch on two NVIDIA A800 GPUs using bfloat16 and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. The learning rate is 10 − 5 10^{-5} with cosine decay and a 0.1 warmup ratio. A per-device batch size of one and 16 gradient-accumulation steps give an effective batch size of 32. The sequence limit is 12,000 tokens, and the qwen3_nothink template disables thinking output. The validation fraction is 0.002, evaluation occurs every 20 steps, and the best checkpoint is loaded at the end. Inference uses deterministic decoding. An auxiliary sample-category prediction supplies the category used to retrieve empirical mean scores from routing training outcomes.
blocks.zh: 训练利用bfloat16和DeepSpeed ZeRO-3更新了两个NVIDIA A800 GPU上一个时代的所有模型参数. 学习速度为10−5 10−5},有余弦衰变和0.1发热比. 每个装置的分批大小为一和16个梯度-累积步骤,有效分批大小为32个。 序列限制为12,000个令牌,而qwen3_nothink模板会禁用思维输出. 鉴定分数为0.002分,每20步进行评分,最优的检分站点在收尾. 推论使用定相解码. 辅助样本类别预测提供了用来从路线培训结果中取出经验平均分的类别。

blocks.en: 7.5 Service Metadata and Eligibility
blocks.zh: 7.5 服务元数据和资格

blocks.en: Execution requirements are obtained from request processing and deployment metadata, including context length, attachment modalities, and required tool support. Eligibility checks compare these requirements with availability and configured service attributes. Optional limits on price rates and first-token latency use the available metadata. Missing values do not independently exclude a candidate. The generation-cost preference is applied separately as a soft selection preference.
blocks.zh: 执行要求来自请求处理和部署元数据,包括上下文长度、附件模式和所需的工具支持。 资格检查将这些要求与可用性和配置的服务属性进行比较. 对价格率的可选限制和先入后出使用现有元数据。 缺失的数值并不排除候选人。 生成成本偏好作为软选择偏好单独适用.

blocks.en: 8 Model Profile Construction and Scoring Details
blocks.zh: 8 模型配置构建和分解细节

blocks.en: 8.1 Outcome Profiles and Missing-Cell Handling
blocks.zh: 8.1 结果简介和失踪处理

blocks.en: Outcome profiles aggregate observed task scores according to capability weights and profiler-assigned difficulty, as defined in the main paper. Both successes and failures contribute, and graded scores retain their original scale. Because one task can require several capabilities, its outcome may inform several cells. Each cell describes performance on tasks that demand the corresponding capability at a specified difficulty.
blocks.zh: 成果简介根据主要文件中界定的能力权重和配置器分配难度,汇总观测到的任务分数。 成功和失败都有贡献,分级分数保留了原来的分数. 由于一项任务可能需要若干种能力,其结果可能为若干个细胞提供参考. 每个单元格都描述了在特定难度下需要相应能力的任务的性能.

blocks.en: For an unobserved cell, lookup uses the nearest observed difficulty level and prefers the higher level in a tie. If a capability has no observed level, it contributes zero. The other capability weights retain their original values rather than being renormalized.
blocks.zh: 对于一个未观测到的单元格,搜索使用最接近的观测到的难度级别,并倾向于在平分中更高等. 如果能力没有观测到的水平,则贡献为零。 其他能力权重保留了原值,而不是被再正常化.

blocks.en: 9.3 Preference-Based and Contrastive Routers

blocks.en: RouteLLM [ 29 ] uses matrix factorization with frozen query embeddings and learned candidate vectors, fitted on 50,000 preference pairs. Our multi-candidate adaptation selects the highest candidate score; the original method applies a threshold to choose between a stronger and a weaker model. RouterDC [ 7 ] uses mDeBERTa-v3-base, candidate embeddings, sample-model and sample-sample contrastive objectives, KMeans semantic groups, and 6,000 training examples; inference selects by cosine similarity. Neither evaluated inference rule applies a separate monetary penalty.
blocks.zh: RouteLLM [29] 使用有被冻结的查询嵌入和学习到的候选矢量的矩阵入子化,被安装在5万对优先配对上. 我们的多功能调整选取最高的候选分数;最初的方法采用一个阈值来选择更强和更弱的模型. RouterDC [7] 使用mDeBERTa-v3-base,候选嵌入,样本-模型和样本-样本对比目标,KMEans语义组,以及6000个培训实例;推论通过同位素相似性选择. 经评估的推断规则都没有适用单独的罚款。

blocks.en: 9.4 Graph-Based and Cluster-Based Routers
blocks.zh: 9.4 以图表和集群为基础的路由器

blocks.en: GraphRouter [ 12 ] represents tasks, queries, and candidates as nodes and uses two edge-aware graph convolution layers with masked-edge prediction. Its three configurations construct training targets from cost-oriented, balanced, and quality-oriented utility, respectively. AvengersPro [ 46 ] summarizes quality and efficiency within query clusters. Our evaluated implementation uses balance parameter 0.5 and aggregates reciprocal candidate ranks from nearby clusters using exponential distance weights. This is the rank-based adaptation of cluster utility scoring used in the reported comparison.
blocks.zh: Graph-Router [12] 代表任务,查询,以及作为节点的候选者,并使用两个带有蒙面-尖端预测的边缘-认知图分层. 其三个组合分别以面向成本、平衡和质量的效用构建培训目标。 AvengersPro [46]总结了查询组内的质量和效率. 我们评价的执行采用平衡参数0.5,对等的候选者排名来自附近的集群,使用指数距离权重。 这是在报告比较中使用的集群效用分数的分级调整。

blocks.en: 9.5 Classification-Based and Retrieval-Based Routers
blocks.zh: 9.5 基于分类和检索的路由器

blocks.en: The classification baselines follow the KNNRouter, SVMRouter, and MLPRouter families provided by LLMRouter [ 13 ] . In our evaluation, they use frozen Longformer embeddings and labels identifying the highest-scoring training candidate. Their decision rules are neighbor-label voting, RBF-kernel classification, and a feed-forward classifier, respectively. Neighbor-label voting predicts a candidate identity; neighborhood performance estimation [ 21 ] instead averages scores separately for each candidate. This distinction separates the KNNRouter comparison from the local quality estimates used by RouteAlign.
blocks.zh: 分类基线遵循LLMRouter提供的KNNRouter、SVMRouter和MLPRouter家庭[13]。 在我们的评价中,他们使用被冻结的Longformer嵌入和标签来识别评分最高的训练候选人. 他们的决定规则分别是相邻的标签投票,RBF-内核分类,以及一个feed-forward分类器. 邻居-标签投票预测候选人身份;邻里业绩估计[21]取而代之的是每个候选人分别得分. 这一区分将KNNRouter比较与RouteAlign所使用的当地质量估计区分开来.

blocks.en: The three embedding-based retrieval policies use the llm-semantic-router checkpoints multi-modal-embed-small , multi-modal-embed-large , and mmbert-embed-32k-2d-matryoshka . MM-Embed-S and MM-Embed-L use 384- and 768-dimensional text embeddings, respectively. The mmBERT-32K configuration uses 768 dimensions, all 22 layers, and a 2,048-token input limit. Each policy averages candidate scores over cosine neighbors and breaks ties using lower neighbor cost. All comparison policies select before response generation under the same benchmark partition.
blocks.zh: 三项基于嵌入式的检索政策采用 " ulm-semantic-router " 检查站的多模式-嵌入式-小模式-多模式-嵌入式-大模式,以及 " mmbert-embed-32k--2d-matryoshka " 。 MM-Embed-S和MM-Embed-L分别使用384-和768-维文本嵌入. mmBERT-32K配置采用了768个尺寸,全部为22层,并有2,048个托肯输入限制. 每个政策平均考生的分数都高于同心邻居, 所有比较政策都在同一基准分配下,在生成反应之前选择。

blocks.en: 11.1 Selection with Cached Requirements and Embeddings
blocks.zh: 11.1 带有缓存要求的选取和嵌入

blocks.en: The runtime table in the main paper measures selection over 3,738 test requests. RouteAlign reuses cached requirement profiles and embeddings; the measured operations are retrieval, feature construction, and candidate scoring. Offline preparation, requirement prediction, embedding construction, and candidate answer generation are excluded. The reported generation charges cover candidate responses and exclude the execution cost of this selection stage.
blocks.zh: 主纸的运行时间表衡量选择量超过3,738个测试请求. RouteAlign再利用缓存的要求配置和嵌入;所测量的操作是检索,特征构建和候选评分. 脱机准备、要求预测、嵌入构造和候选答案生成不在此列。 报告的生成费包括候选人的答复,不包括这一甄选阶段的执行费用。

blocks.en: 11.2 Endpoint Latency with Online Requirement Prediction
blocks.zh: 11.2 有在线要求预测的终点

blocks.en: The separate endpoint runs the 0.6B requirement profiler and selects candidates using a 500-request reference bank. It computes candidate separation independently for each request as the unnormalized maximum local quality minus the mean. When sample-category metadata is absent, difficulty-level and global reference means replace the category-by-difficulty and category means, respectively. These settings define the request-level serving configuration.
blocks.zh: 单独的端点运行了0.6B要求剖析器,并使用500个请求参考库来选择候选人. 它独立计算每个请求的候选人离职,作为未正常化的最大局部质量减去平均值. 当样本类元数据缺失时,难度级和全球参考值分别取代了"逐类困难"和"分类"等手段. 这些设置定义了请求级别服务配置.

blocks.en: The reported run processes 96 requests at concurrency 32. Timing covers requirement prediction and selection, ending before candidate answer generation. The resulting median latency is 0.60 seconds, the 95th-percentile latency is 0.74 seconds, and throughput is 51.2 requests per second, with no observed errors or fallbacks.
blocks.zh: 所报告的运行程序以32为货币处理96项请求。 时间安排包括需求预测和选择,在候选人答复生成之前结束。 由此得出的中位点为0.60秒,第95分点为0.74秒,吞吐量为每秒51.2个请求,没有观察到出错或回落.

New candidate measurements come from reference evaluations performed before those candidates enter selection. All RouteAlign-Frozen results, including T8, use the T0-fitted coefficients; the fixed-catalog experiment uses coefficients fitted on all 13 candidates.

blocks.en: 13 Decision-Model Implementations and Detailed Results
blocks.zh: 13 决策模式执行和详细结果

blocks.en: 13.1 Backend Implementations
blocks.zh: 13.1 后端执行

blocks.en: The comparison uses local adaptations of the five open projects in Table 12 , instantiated at nine model sizes. Kev uses LoRA adapters and a pointer head, Open-Jev uses LoRA with a scalar decision head, and Decider uses fully fine-tuned models with option-letter logit readout. SemIf and OpenJev-mjdileep read pretrained-model logits. The experiments use the Qwen3.5-based versions listed below. All nine backends are evaluated without additional fine-tuning on the routing workload.
blocks.zh: 比较采用表12中5个开口项目的局部改造,即时化为9个型号. Kev使用LORA适配器并使用指针头,Open-Jev使用带有scalar决定头的LORA,Concer使用带有选项字母登录读取功能的完全微调模型. SemIf和OpenJev-mjdileep读取了预先训练过的模型日志. 这些实验使用以下以Quen3.5为基础的版本. 所有9个后端都经过评估,但没有对线路工作量作额外的微调.

blocks.en: Table 12 : Open implementations used in the Jev-style comparison. Project names link to their repositories, and checkpoint identifiers specify the evaluated Qwen3.5-based models. SemIf and OpenJev-mjdileep use pretrained base checkpoints directly.
blocks.zh: 表12:Jev风格比较中使用的开放式执行. 项目名称与其寄存器的链接,检查站标识符指定了被评价的以Quen3.5为基础的模型. SemIf和OpenJev-mjdileep直接使用经过训练的基地检查站。

blocks.en: The local adapter follows the state-and-questions structure of the Jev decision interface . Open-Jev uses a locally constructed candidate prompt following the published scoring interface; Decider follows its model-card protocol. Kev processes question branches as separate causal sequences in a batch to accommodate the recurrent components of its backbone. Its state and combined state-question limits are 384 and 1,024 tokens, respectively. Released temperature parameters are loaded with the checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 本地适配器遵循Jev决定界面的状态和问题结构 . Open-Jev使用在已公布的评分界面后本地构建的候选快取;决定者遵循其模型卡协议. Kev进程在批次中将分支作为单独的因果序列来提问,以适应其骨干中反复出现的组成部分. 其状态和综合状态问题限制分别为384个和1,024个令牌. 释放的温度参数被装入检查站。

blocks.en: 13.2 Requirement Prediction and Candidate Scoring
blocks.zh: 13.2 要求预测和候选人评分

blocks.en: One decision call contains 12 questions: ten four-level capability-demand scores, one L1–L4 difficulty choice, and one tool-requirement judgment. Each capability score is its expected ordinal level divided by three. Values below 0.05 are removed before the remaining weights are normalized. Tool use is required when its affirmative probability exceeds 0.5. The adapter then applies metadata filtering and matches candidates by the primary capability and predicted difficulty, using its configured tier fallback.
blocks.zh: 一个裁判呼叫包含12个问题:10个四级能力需求分数,1个L1-L4难度选择,以及1个工具需求判断. 每个能力分是其预期正数分除以3. 0.05以下的值被去除后再将所余重量恢复正常. 当肯定概率超过0.5时,需要使用工具。 适配器然后采用元数据过滤并按主能力和预测难度匹配候选人,使用所配置的分级倒置.

blocks.en: Candidate scoring receives the query truncated to 1,200 characters and a task summary. Each candidate description contains up to five capabilities selected by current demand, their difficulty-specific measurements, specialty tags, and service attributes, within a 700-character profile budget. The decision score maps the expected four-level performance rating to [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] . For decision score J ⁡ ( x , m ) J(x,m) and explicit profile compatibility C ⁡ ( x , m ) C(x,m) , the final score is H ρ ​ ( x , m ) = ρ ​ J ​ ( x , m ) + ( 1 − ρ ) ​ C ​ ( x , m ) , ρ ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } . H_{\rho}(x,m)=\rho J(x,m)+(1-\rho)C(x,m),\qquad\rho\in\{0,0.5,1\}. (13) Here C ⁡ ( x , m ) C(x,m) sums the adapter’s profile measurements weighted by the backend-predicted requirements at the predicted difficulty. At ρ = 0 \rho=0 , compatibility supplies the candidate score, while the backend determines the task requirements and resulting candidate set. The mixtures combine backend predictions with supplied global profile measurements; RouteAlign additionally uses retrieved local outcomes and its fitted ten-feature scorer. The shared workload and catalog support comparison of these complete selection policies.
blocks.zh: 考生得分后会收到1200个字符的查询和任务摘要。 每个候选描述包含最多由当前需求选择的5个能力,其难度特异性的测量,特异性标记,以及服务属性,在一个700个特征描述预算范围内. 决策分数将预期的四级业绩评级映射为[0,10] [0,10]. 对于决定分分J(x,m)J(x,m)和明确剖面相容性C(x,m)C(x,m)C(x,m),最终分为H ρ(x,m) ρ(x,m)+(1-)C(x,m)C(x,m),ρ (0,0.5,m). H_{\rho J(x,m)+(1-rho)C(x,m),\qquad\rhoin(x)0,0.5,1\} (13) 这里C(x,m)C(x,m)C(x,m)在预测困难时将后端预测要求加权的适配方的剖面测量值相加起来. 在 ^ = 0\rho= 0. 时,相容性提供候选分数,而后端则确定任务要求并由此产生候选分数. 混合物将后端预测与所提供的全球剖面测量结合起来; RouteAlign额外使用回收的本地结果及其安装的十地分仪。 分担的工作量和目录有助于对这些完整的甄选政策进行比较。

blocks.en: The experiment saves both component scores and replays the three mixtures over the same candidate sets. Outcomes and generation charges are looked up only after selection. Every backend covers all 3,738 test requests, including successfully retried records. The implementation uses PyTorch 2.9.1, Transformers 5.3.0, PEFT 0.20.0, and bfloat16 inference on one A800 GPU.
blocks.zh: 实验既能节省组件分数,又能将三种混合物重放于同一套候选组合上. 成果和生成费用只有在选定后才予以考虑。 每个后端覆盖所有3,738个测试请求,包括成功重审的记录. 实施时使用PyTorch 2.9.1,变形器 5.3.0,PEFT 0.20.0,并用bfloat16推论取自一款A800 GPU.

blocks.en: 13.3 Complete Mixture Results
blocks.zh: 13.3 完整的混合结果

blocks.en: Table 13 provides quality and generation expenditure for all 27 configurations. The best configuration under both aggregate metrics is Decider-4B with explicit compatibility scoring. RouteAlign improves on it by 6.44 Dataset-Avg points and 5.22 Sample-Avg points at 9.7% lower generation expenditure. Intermediate mixtures help some backends, including Open-Jev-2B and SemIf-4B, while Decider-4B performs best at ρ = 0 \rho=0 . RouteAlign’s aggregate advantage is sustained across this variation in backend and scoring mixture.
